errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested book is not found in the system during a lookup operation.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested member is not found in the system during a lookup operation.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested loan is not found in the system during a lookup operation.

errors.name: BookAlreadyLoanedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to loan a book that is already actively borrowed.

errors.name: MemberNotAuthorizedError
errors.description: Raised when a member attempts to borrow a book without proper authorization, such as not being a registered member.
